scope: Local data audit for TTM migration; metadata is not a reconstruction of quarterly EPS.
why_data_are_missing: The acquisition SQL restricted EPS rows to qtrs=4; non-annual rows in the file are stock-split facts, not quarterly earnings.
metadata_limitations: A match to the latest 10-K/10-Q period is only a candidate for a latest annual TTM anchor. An earlier 8-K/company earnings release can disclose a later quarter before the 10-Q is filed.
DERA period/ddate is rounded to nearest month-end; neither exact fiscal dates nor period_start may be invented from this directory.
The 36 matching annual candidates are not automatically certified TTM inputs; no flags in the existing annual data were changed.

minimum_reliable_research_method.name: four_quarter_diluted_eps_sum
requirements: Four explicitly reported non-overlapping consecutive quarters, covering the fiscal 12-month/52-53-week window.
Every source was public at the decision cutoff; reconcile issuer, class, currency, accounting presentation, and split basis separately for each source vintage.
Use actual fiscal start/end dates from statements; preserve source accession and availability.
Record the approximation and retain missing-data entries; never silently substitute stale annual earnings.
minimum_reliable_research_method.anti_double_adjustment_note: The six annual share adjustments are bound to their annual accessions. A post-split quarterly filing may already restate prior quarters, so the annual multiplier must not be applied blindly to the new quarterly inputs.

cliff_example.difference_reason: Independent diluted-share denominators and rounding; use the stated method consistently.

accounting_sources.summary: 2012 filing explains that quarterly and full-year diluted EPS are computed independently and need not add.
2012 filing explains exclusion of potential ordinary shares when continuing operations are loss-making under the anti-dilution control test.
EPS reconciliation shows numerator and denominator adjustments; averaged reported diluted shares alone do not constitute an exact 12-month recomputation.

full_gaap_recomputation_requires: Common-shareholder EPS numerator and adjustments, including preferred dividends and convertible interest where applicable.
Continuing-operations control earnings and two-class allocation.
Time-weighted basic shares and potential-common-share details over the entire 12-month interval.
A fresh full-period dilution/anti-dilution test, consistent stock-split basis, and restatement vintage.
provenance_note: This JSON is a sourced evidence summary; source URLs were read but complete original web bytes were not archived in this task.
